label: Environment variable substitution (Sync Gateway configuration)
type: the ${VARNAME} placeholder syntax Sync Gateway resolves against process environment variables inside bootstrap or legacy Pre-3.0 configuration files. Case-sensitive (${username} != ${USERNAME}). Values are read once at startup - not detected while running - so a change only takes effect after a Sync Gateway restart, unless unsupported.allow_dbconfig_env_vars is set to false to skip expansion in database configs entirely.
note: Not available in persistent per-database config the same way - configured only via the two file-based surfaces (bootstrap, legacy).
